remarks: Completely renovated 2-bedroom, 1-bath first-floor unit in the heart of Downtown Stamford! This bright and spacious home features 9-foot ceilings throughout, a brand-new eat-in kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances, an in-unit washer and dryer, and beautifully updated finishes throughout. Relax on the inviting front porch or enjoy the convenience of off-street parking. Optional locked basement storage is available for an additional $100/month. Tenant pays all utilities. Gas heat.  Ideally located just steps from Downtown Stamford's restaurants, shopping, theaters, nightlife, and Mill River Park, with easy access to Metro-North, I-95, and only one hour from New York City. Enjoy the perfect combination of modern living and an unbeatable walkable location.
